Milk Specialties Company.note: Butterfly Equity completed its acquisition of Milk Specialties Company (doing business as Milk Specialties Global) in the first quarter of 2023, and the company later rebranded as Actus Nutrition in 2024.

Vitalus Nutrition Inc..note: Fulcrum Capital Partners made a majority equity investment in Vitalus Nutrition Inc. in January 2017.

Ventria Bioscience, Inc..note: Ventria Bioscience sold its plant-made biomanufacturing technology to ExpressTec LLC in 2023 and the remaining business was renamed InVitria, Inc.

Ace International.note: Ace International remains an independent company, recently completing an institutional fundraising round in 2025.

Beijing Guoke Xinglian Technology Co., L.note: Beijing Guoke Xinglian Technology Co., Ltd. operates independently and recently raised Series A+ extension funding in 2026.

Fido Pharma.note: Fido Pharma operates as an independent venture offering wellness and probiotic products under its Meibotan brand.

Laboratorium Ofichem B.V..note: Laboratorium Ofichem B.V. is a family-owned independent CDMO that unified its internal brands under the single Ofichem name in 2026.

Pharming Group N.V..note: Pharming Group N.V. is a publicly traded independent biopharmaceutical company that has acts as an acquirer rather than being acquired.

Shaanxi TNJONE Pharmaceutical Technology.note: Shaanxi TNJONE Pharmaceutical Technology Co., Ltd. operates independently as a manufacturer and exporter of raw pharmaceutical ingredients.

YANGGE Biotech Co., Ltd.note: YANGGE Biotech Co., Ltd. is an independent global supplier specialized in natural plant extracts and nutritional ingredients.
